messages:
marta: Quick note284A2
Repro: generic overloads in our TS SDK lose inference when bundled for Edge (Vite -> esbuild). Works in Node/CJS.

devon: paste the minimal snippet?

marta: 
```ts
export function fetcher<T>(p: string, opts?: { body?: T }): Promise<{ data: T }>;
export function fetcher(p: string, opts?: any) { /* impl */ }
```
Callsite `await fetcher<User>(...)` becomes `any` in the edge bundle.

sandeep: likely packaging/d.ts issue or moduleResolution differences. Are you bundling .d.ts?

marta: yes, our build currently post-processes d.ts. Importing from src keeps types; importing from dist breaks.

rachel: also check runtime parity: our retry/fetch wrapper returns `Response | undefined` on edge vs `Response` on node. That union can widen generics.

devon: quick fixes: avoid bundling d.ts, emit tsc .d.ts directly with declarationMap, and add a platform fetch adapter with stable types. Also add a CI test: install built package into the small-app template and run Vite + typecheck.

ci-bot: Issue created #1270 "Edge bundle: overload inference lost due to d.ts packaging + runtime parity" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1270 :robot_face:

marta: created minimal repro and PR to stop bundling d.ts. Will add adapter and CI job. Thanks everyone.
